settings.text: Banggz is a Canadian-Nigerian rap artist and producer. Bridging his West African heritage with contemporary Western textures, he has carved a definitive lane in modern music with his signature Afro-rap style.

Born in Jos and raised in Lagos after his family relocated due to insurgency, he found purpose in turning displacement into direction. The pulse of Lagos became his classroom, shaping a sound rooted in sharp resilience, raw ambition, and a journalistic approach to lyricism. Now based in Canada, Banggz translates complex, real-world human experiences into high-rotation, infectious grooves.
